services.label: Share of people receiving home and community-based services
services.method: Number of people in the group divided by the number of people of all races and ethnicities receiving home and community-based services in the same county. People whose race is unknown count in the total but in no group.

comparison.label: Service share compared with population share
comparison.method: Service share divided by population share. 1 means the group's share of people receiving services matches its share of the county population. Shown only when at least 11 people in the group receive services.

earned-income.label: People receiving waiver services who earned income
earned-income.populationFilterPlain: Everyone receiving waiver services (the broadest group in the file)

nonEnglish.label: People who speak a language other than English at home
nonEnglish.date: American Community Survey 5-year estimates; the sheet is labeled 2017-2021 and the file's notes name 2018-2022
nonEnglish.note: The file's two language column labels are reversed. The value used is the one labeled "% Speak English", which is the smaller share and matches the statewide share of people who speak another language at home.

sources.title: Overall Minnesota population demographics, accessible version
sources.publisher: Minnesota Department of Human Services (from United States Census Bureau population estimates and the American Community Survey)

definitions.county: County means the county of financial responsibility: the county responsible for paying for a person's services. It may not be where the person lives.
definitions.suppression: The Department of Human Services shows counts under 6 as "<6". Those values are left out here and marked suppressed. A service share is left out when its count is under 6. An earned income percent is left out when its count of people with earned income is under 6. A comparison is shown only when at least 11 people in the group receive services.
definitions.notReported: A value is left out when the source has no row for that county and group.
definitions.otherReportingUnitsNote: Some people's services are paid for by a multi-county human services agency or a Tribal Nation. The source counts those people under that agency or Nation, not under a county, so they are in the Statewide figures but in no county figure.
